basics.name: Pepper Pancoast
basics.label: Senior Director of Engineering
basics.summary: Engineering leader with 12+ years of experience building and scaling enterprise cloud platforms and healthcare interoperability networks. At Netsmart, I lead a global organization of ~30 engineers, architects, and managers across the US and India—building and running CareFabric and CareConnect, the core cloud backbone and interoperability engines powering clinical data exchange across Netsmart's EHR ecosystem and national healthcare networks.

work.name: Netsmart
work.position: Senior Director of Engineering (CareFabric & CareConnect Platforms)
work.summary: Lead a global organization of ~30 engineers, architects, and managers across the US and India, owning Netsmart's enterprise cloud backbone (CareFabric) and healthcare interoperability platform (CareConnect).
highlights: CareFabric Cloud Platform: Direct the architecture and reliability of Netsmart's shared services backbone on AWS—powering synchronous action routing, Kafka/MSK event streaming, unified clinical data stores, Master Patient Index (MPI), and SMART-on-FHIR identity across multi-tenant EHRs.

CareConnect & National Networks: Drive engineering delivery across TEFCA / QHIN, Carequality, Certified FHIR R4 APIs, HL7/CDA integration engines, and federal regulatory mandates (ONC HTI-1/HTI-4, CMS-0057-F, 42 CFR Part 2).
Cloud FinOps & Resiliency: Led a cross-platform AWS optimization initiative delivering six-figure annual recurring savings while advancing multi-region BCDR and edge caching performance.
AI-Native Engineering: Built and rolled out multi-agent AI workflows (MCP) for automated PR triage, rapid architecture spec lookup, and incident-to-coaching handoffs—cutting diagnostic toil by >90%.

work.name: Netsmart
work.summary: Led multi-disciplinary engineering teams across the CareFabric and CareConnect platforms, driving cloud modernization, regulatory compliance, and national network scale.
highlights: Scaled US and India engineering teams owning core platform services, API gateways, clinical data pipelines, and interoperability hubs serving thousands of provider organizations.
Directed foundational engineering execution enabling Netsmart to become the first Designated QHIN built fully on AWS, supporting 6.5B+ annual clinical queries.
Spearheaded the modernization and retirement of legacy clinical portals and message brokers into resilient, cloud-native AWS architectures.
Partnered with executive and product leadership to establish predictable multi-quarter capacity planning, DevSecOps governance, and high-availability SLAs.

work.name: Cerner Corporation
work.summary: Managed software engineering teams and coordinated cross-border clinical platform development across multiple countries, languages, and technical stacks.
highlights: Directed international software engineering teams, driving agile delivery, capacity planning, and cross-functional alignment.
Guided career progression, goal setting, and technical mentorship for software engineers and team leads.
Fostered an engineering-led innovation culture through internal hackathons ('ShipIt' days) to accelerate feature ideation and rapid prototyping.

work.name: Cerner Corporation
work.summary: Designed and developed core enterprise clinical platform components and internal engineering velocity tooling.
highlights: Architected and built core clinical system components utilizing Java/J2EE, JavaScript, Ruby, and RESTful APIs.
Built custom internal engineering analytics and sprint-tracking automation using the Jira REST API.
Completed the competitive Cerner Velocity Software Engineering Internship prior to transitioning into full-time platform engineering.
